from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/components/Equalizer31Band.tsx')
lines = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8').split('\n')
out = []
for line in lines:
    out.append(line)
    if line.strip() == 'onFeedback,' and any('export default function Equalizer31Band' in l for l in []):
        pass
# insert after the onFeedback, line that is inside the destructure (first occurrence after component decl)
try:
    start = next(i for i,l in enumerate(out) if l.startswith('export default function Equalizer31Band'))
except StopIteration:
    start = -1
for i in range(start, len(out)):
    if out[i].strip() == 'onFeedback,':
        out.insert(i+1, '  onTasteChange,')
        break
p.write_text('\n'.join(out), encoding='utf-8')
print('\n'.join(out[start:start+12]))
PY
